topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Rain's been giving the city a good soak today, but it's nothing a good pair of boots can't handle. Been thinking about that old place on Elm Street, the one the Johnsons just inherited. Used to be Grandma Johnson's, a real character she was. Place probably holds more secrets than a locked safe. Good thing those siblings are close, don't see this kind of windfall tearing them apart like it has others. They got the chance to make some real good choices, maybe even do something nice for the neighborhood. Gotta respect when family looks out for each other, especially in a town as tight-lipped as this one. Might pay them a visit, see what the future holds for that old house.
